# Indium bumps

Indium bumps are listed for completeness; they do not suit 250 µm solder
balls. Evaporated In with a thin Ti/Ni/Au under-bump metal (UBM) by lift-off
is the standard for pixel detector hybridisation ([psi-indium]). It is a
cleanroom wafer process aimed at 20 to 50 µm pitch and cold compression
bonding, not at 250 µm reflow balls.

## Fit

**Low.**
